findings.evidence: `JHolomorphicContinuity.lean:7` imports only `TauCeti.Geometry.Symplectic.JHolomorphic`; `JHolomorphicContinuity.lean:54` starts `IsJHolomorphicAt.continuousAt`, while `JHolomorphic.lean:137` already has `IsJHolomorphicAt.differentiableAt`, `JHolomorphic.lean:181` has `IsJHolomorphicWithinAt.differentiableWithinAt`, and `JHolomorphic.lean:303` has `IsJHolomorphic.isJHolomorphicOn`.
findings.fix: Move these lemmas into `TauCeti/Geometry/Symplectic/JHolomorphic.lean` near `IsJHolomorphicAt.differentiableAt`, `IsJHolomorphicWithinAt.differentiableWithinAt`, and `IsJHolomorphic.isJHolomorphicOn`, or otherwise place all basic regularity consequences in the core J-holomorphic API file.
findings.issue: The declarations in this file are immediate regularity consequences of the core `IsJHolomorphic*` predicates and depend only on `TauCeti.Geometry.Symplectic.JHolomorphic`; splitting them into a later module hides basic API from users of the canonical predicate file, which already contains adjacent derivative/differentiability consequences.

summary: The new regularity API is broadly useful core API for the existing `IsJHolomorphic*` predicates and belongs with the core predicate file, not in a later continuity-only module.
